items.title: Which retail stocks are best positioned ahead of earnings this week?
items.summary: Investing.com -- Six retailers still report this week, per the earnings calendar: Lowe’s (LOW), TJX (TJX) and Target (TGT) on Nov 18 pre-market, then Walmart (WMT) pre-market and PDD Holdings (PDD) on Nov 19. Ross Stores (ROST) reports after the close on Nov 19. Home Depot (HD) already reported this morning, so it is excluded. The calendar was filtered to high- and medium-importance names, so smaller retailers may be missing.

items.title: Home Depot CFO Richard McPhail to become retailer's next CEO
items.summary: Home Depot (HD) announces that CFO Richard McPhail will step up to become the next CEO, replacing Ted Decker, effective November 23. Decker will serve in a new role as the company's chair. The 8:30 Hosts Jake Conley, Julie Hyman, and Pras Subramanian discuss the significance of this headline reported alongside Home Depot's third quarter earnings results.

items.title: Help Open a Door for a Young Person This Holiday Season: The Home Depot Canada Foundation's Orange Door Project Campaign Is Back
items.summary: More than 35,000 young people in Canada are experiencing homelessness. This holiday season, The Home Depot Canada Foundation is asking Canadians to help create new pathways for youth through its annual Orange Door Project holiday campaign. 100% of funds raised stay in the community where they are donated, and every donation made on Giving Tuesday, December 1, will be matched.

items.title: Wall Street Analysts See Walmart (WMT) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Walmart (WMT) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?
